target.name: Western Asset Emerging Markets Income Fund Inc.

acquirer.name: Western Asset Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc.

listed_quote.quote: Western Asset Emerging Markets Income Fund Inc. (NYSE: EMD), Western Asset Worldwide Income Fund Inc. (NYSE: SBW) and Western Asset Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc. (NYSE: ESD)

announcement.quote: announced approval by each Fund’s Board of Directors of a proposal to merge (i) EMD with and into ESD and (ii) SBW with and into ESD, subject to approval by the stockholders of each Fund.

deals.notes: EMD's own N-8F (seq=4, 0001193125-17-023031, filed 2017-01-30) ticks Merger as the reason to deregister and says the shareholder vote took place December 12, 2016, but the excerpt does not state that the merger closed and does not name the acquirer, so outcome left null. The DEF 14A (seq=3) shown is an annual-meeting proxy about electing directors and does not state the merger outcome.

target.name: Western Asset Worldwide Income Fund Inc.

acquirer.name: Western Asset Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc.

listed_quote.quote: Western Asset Emerging Markets Income Fund Inc. (NYSE: EMD), Western Asset Worldwide Income Fund Inc. (NYSE: SBW) and Western Asset Emerging Markets Debt Fund Inc. (NYSE: ESD)

announcement.quote: announced approval by each Fund’s Board of Directors of a proposal to merge (i) EMD with and into ESD and (ii) SBW with and into ESD, subject to approval by the stockholders of each Fund.

deals.notes: The 8-K says the approval of each merger is not contingent upon the approval of the other merger. No excerpted filing is about SBW's outcome (the N-8F shown is EMD's), so outcome is null.

problems: The outcome of neither merger is stated in the excerpts. The 8-K and the 425 were filed the same day; the 8-K was taken as the announcement.
